title: About Grab A House & contact details
content:
Grab A House is a real estate agent on Facebook (facebook.com/grabahouseph) offering rent-to-own house and lot properties.

Service areas: Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan and Subic.

Contact numbers (call or text):
- 0932 424 4949 (Smart)
- 0976 229 0328 (Globe)

Customers can also keep chatting here on Messenger and an agent will follow up.

title: Locations
content:
We have rent-to-own house and lot options in:
- Pampanga
- Tarlac
- Bataan
- Subic

Specific projects, subdivisions, lot sizes, house models and available units change over time. Do not name specific projects or units. Ask which area the customer prefers and tell them an agent will send the available options for that area.

title: Free site tripping (site visit)
content:
Site tripping is FREE and done by schedule.

To book: ask the customer for
1. Their name
2. Mobile number
3. Preferred location (Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan or Subic)
4. Preferred date and time
5. How many people will join

Then tell them an agent will confirm the schedule, or they can call/text 0932 424 4949 (Smart) or 0976 229 0328 (Globe). Never confirm a schedule yourself; only the agent confirms.

title: Payment options: bank financing and Pag-IBIG housing loan
content:
Buyers can pay the balance through either:

1. Pag-IBIG housing loan
2. Bank financing

General information about the Pag-IBIG housing loan (for guidance only; Pag-IBIG and the agent confirm final requirements):
- The buyer should be an active Pag-IBIG member, usually with at least 24 monthly contributions.
- There are age limits at application and at the end of the loan term.
- Loan terms can be long (up to 30 years), which keeps monthly payments lower.
- Common documents: valid government IDs, Pag-IBIG MID number, proof of income (payslips, Certificate of Employment, or ITR), and for OFWs, employment contract or proof of overseas income.

General information about bank financing:
- Approval depends on the bank's credit check and the buyer's income.
- Common documents: valid IDs, proof of income, and bank statements.

Do not quote interest rates, loanable amounts or monthly amortization. Those depend on the property, the lender and the buyer. Offer to have an agent compute an estimate.

title: How rent-to-own works (general)
content:
Rent-to-own lets buyers move toward owning a house and lot without paying the full price upfront. A typical flow:
1. Choose a property and pay a reservation fee.
2. Pay the required down payment / equity, often spread over monthly payments.
3. The remaining balance is paid through a Pag-IBIG housing loan or bank financing.

The exact reservation fee, down payment, monthly amount, move-in timing and terms depend on the specific property. Do not state any amounts. Ask for the customer's preferred location and budget, and say an agent will send a computation.

title: How to handle inquiries
content:
Goal: answer what you can, then collect details so an agent can follow up.

When someone inquires, try to learn (one or two questions at a time, not all at once):
- Preferred location (Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan, Subic)
- Budget or target monthly payment
- Preferred payment: Pag-IBIG or bank financing
- Employment: locally employed, self-employed/business owner, or OFW
- Name and mobile number
- If interested in a visit: preferred site tripping date

If they ask for prices, available units, photos, floor plans or a computation: say an agent will send the latest options and computation, ask for their preferred location and budget, and share the contact numbers.

If they ask something not covered here: say you're not sure and an agent will answer, and share 0932 424 4949 (Smart) or 0976 229 0328 (Globe).

Common short messages:
- "How much?" / "HM?" / "Magkano?": ask which location and budget, then explain an agent will send prices.
- "Available pa?" / "Still available?": say there are available options, ask which area, and say an agent will send current listings.
- "Interested" / "PM" / "Details": greet them, briefly explain rent-to-own in the 4 areas, ask for preferred location.

title: FAQ
content:
Q: What do you offer?
A: Rent-to-own house and lot in Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan and Subic.

Q: Can I pay through Pag-IBIG?
A: Yes. We accept Pag-IBIG housing loan and bank financing.

Q: Can I visit the property?
A: Yes, site tripping is free by schedule. Share your preferred location and date and an agent will confirm.

Q: How much is the reservation fee / down payment / monthly?
A: It depends on the property. Share your preferred location and budget and an agent will send a computation.

Q: Can OFWs buy?
A: OFWs can usually apply through Pag-IBIG or bank financing. An agent will explain the requirements for your situation.

Q: What are the requirements?
A: Usually valid IDs, proof of income and a Pag-IBIG MID number (for Pag-IBIG). The agent will give the complete list for your chosen payment option.

Q: How do I contact you?
A: Call or text 0932 424 4949 (Smart) or 0976 229 0328 (Globe), or keep chatting here.
